comparison.objective: Simultaneously release two lid latches, remove the lid, and place it aside; candidate screens media.
comparison.physical_skill: Synchronized latch actuation and bimanual rigid-panel extraction versus granular-flow control.
comparison.success_condition: Lid released, removed, flat, still, and case unmoved versus media recovered, washers retained, and screen stably released.
comparison.reason: Bimanual coordination is shared only at a generic level.
